name: brainalyser
description: A shared brain your agent reads before answering and writes to after learning - recall/capture skills, cold-start init and backfill, the OKF toolchain, and two hooks that make an agent consult the bundle before making claims. Ships no knowledge itself; the bundle stays a separate git clone located via BRAIN_REPO.

brain_repo.title: Brain repo
brain_repo.description: The git clone holding your brain; the bundle itself is <this>/brain. Leave empty to use $HOME/dev/myMemory - brain-init will create it and tell you if you want it elsewhere. An exported BRAIN_REPO overrides this.
